reason: A DSH conversation-control plugin that lets users interrupt active turns, rewind to a user message, edit the restored draft, and exclude the later conversation tail from subsequent model context while retaining append-only logs.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 中回退到指定用户消息、打断进行中的回复、编辑恢复的草稿，并从后续模型上下文中隐藏回退点之后内容的会话控制插件。
summaries.en: A DSH conversation-control plugin for rewinding to a selected user message, interrupting an active response, editing the restored draft, and excluding the later conversation tail from subsequent model context.

capabilities: rewind conversations to a selected user message
hide subsequent messages from the chat view and model context
preserve rewind state across process restarts
